nightly-bot: Nightly eval alert for redwood-v2-7b-quant-opt.20q — long_context_promptset: instr_loss increased from 2.1% -> 34.6% (run 2248901200). Failing prompts clustered at tail of >32k token sessions. 

maya: saw the alert. I pulled a few failing samples from the csv, attaching one below.

maya: ```
PROMPT: [system instructions repeated at start] ... <very long doc> ...
User: Please follow the instructions and list the three main points.

MODEL OUTPUT (truncated):
1. The first item...
2. The second item...

[stops responding — no '3.' or further instruction-following]
```

alex: interesting — does the kv cache wrap around? can you paste the runtime logs for that session id?

sam: repro command I ran: `./eval_harness --model redwood-v2-7b-quant-opt.20q --prompt-id doc-long-042 --max-toks 512 --longctx 65536 --seed 42`
sam: output snippet from runner: ```
[2024-11-08T02:14:01Z] session=abc123 kv_slot=4095 write_index=4095
[2024-11-08T02:14:01Z] session=abc123 kv_slot=0 write_index=0  <-- wrapped
[2024-11-08T02:14:01Z] generate: emitted token_count=124, stopped_reason=stop_sequence
[2024-11-08T02:14:01Z] trace: last_instruction_presence=false
```

lee: hmm log shows wrap at 4095 -> 0, which matches our 4096-slot circular buffer. but we shouldn't be evicting active prefix. check prefetch/prefill window size and prefix-anchor metadata.

maya: note: this only repros on the quantized build (20q). float32 nightly baseline doesn't show the regression. also only on sequences with many repeated system tokens (we reuse the same prompt header).

alex: that points at an indexing bug in the kv-stitch path for quantized kernels — maybe an off-by-one when we map logical seqnum -> ring buffer index after quantized remap. I can add instrumentation to print logical_seq -> slot mapping for the session.

sam: quick bisect: earlier quant builds (opt.18q) are clean; opt.19q starts to show small noise; opt.20q is noisy. change between 19->20 includes kernel prefetch optimization + pack layout change.

maya: reproduction artifacts: saved session abc123 with full kv snapshot (S3: s3://redwood-nightly/repro/224890/abc123.kv). also attached failing prompt ids in the eval CSV.

alex: action items:
- alex: add temporary logging in runtime to dump `logical_seqnum -> kv_slot` for the whole session (will grep for wrap points). ETA: EOD today.
- lee: verify prefetch config for quantized kernels and test with prefetch disabled on a small repro. ETA: tomorrow morning.
- sam: run targeted evals across builds opt.18/19/20 with longctx=65536 for the failing prompts and attach perf traces. ETA: EOD.
- maya: create a narrow unit test that simulates repeated system-header + long doc to exercise prefix anchoring. ETA: after alex logs.

sam: also adding a short-term mitigation: can we pin max prefix retention to 48k tokens in the scheduler for quant builds until root cause fixed?

lee: we can add a runtime guard. i'll prototype a check that refuses to evict a slot still referenced by any active session. low-risk flag.

maya: thanks all — assigning the thread to alex for signal collection. please paste links to logs/artifacts here when available. :pray:
